description: Carte des Jeux - Road Events (EN) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère chargé des Sports. Geodata - Liste des road events de Paris 2024 (EN). Coverage: Ministère chargé des Sports. The publisher named on the listing is Ministère chargé des Sports. Its keywords include sport-jeunesse-et-vie-associative. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2024-09-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
